Card Q&A.q: Can this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect give "can't unsuspend" to a card that was not suspended by it?

Effect: When this card would be played, if there are 2 or more suspended Digimon, reduce the cost by 4.

[On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. 1 of their Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend until their turn ends. Then, 1 of your Digimon can't be deleted in battle until their turn ends.
